full_title: AirSwasthya AI: Explainable AQI Forecasting and Health-Risk Advisory System for Urban Safety
version_scope: Review 2 Odisha-first explainable AQI/PM2.5 system without deep learning or LSTM
readiness_note: GitHub publication package is about 85% ready; Review 2 implementation demo is about 80% ready; final academic submission still needs report, PPT, screenshots, literature, and local validation evidence.
claim_boundary: Current PM2.5 forecast metrics validate a recent gridded Open-Meteo demo series, not certified local ground-station daily accuracy.
protection_note: Ownership is documented through attribution, manifest, progress notes, visuals, and report material. The code remains readable for academic review.
